name: de.bookvia/bookvia
title: Bookvia
description: Find local service businesses in Germany, see free times, request quotes and book appointments.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Searches Bookvia's directory of local service businesses in Germany by job (query, everyday German words) and place (location: postal code, district, neighbourhood or town). Returns matching businesses with their matching services and price ranges, which are stated by the business and are not binding quotes. results holds only businesses that confirmed their own data, and can be empty: empty results means Bookvia has no business listed for this search. A separate list, unverified, can hold entries from public data (not businesses that confirmed anything), always verified: false. interpretation shows how trade and place were understood; if interpretation.clarification is set, the search was ambiguous and may not have run. remote_ok: true includes businesses that work online or by phone (remote_available counts them). urgent: true, when the customer says the job is urgent, lists first the businesses that state they react within one hour right now. The order follows how well a business fits.

query.description: Free text in German describing the job, e.g. "Steckdose in der Küche setzen" or "Heizungswartung"

category.description: Trade or industry to filter by

location.description: Where the job is, as the customer said it: German postal code, district, neighbourhood or town, e.g. "12047", "Kreuzberg", "Berlin-Neukölln". Preferred over district and postal_code.

district.description: Berlin district or neighbourhood, e.g. "Neukölln", "Kreuzberg", "Prenzlauer Berg"

postal_code.description: German 5-digit postal code of the job location

offset.description: Skip this many results. Use next_offset from the previous answer to get the next page

remote_ok.description: true if the customer is fine with a provider who works online or by phone instead of coming by, e.g. for tax, legal or business advice, coaching, translation, tutoring, web design or IT for offices. Businesses anywhere in Germany that work remotely are then included, local ones first

urgent.description: true if the customer said the job is urgent, e.g. the heating is off or water is leaking (urgency comes from the customer, not from the kind of job). Businesses that state they react within one hour at this moment are then listed first, see reacts_within_1h

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Full verified profile of one business: services with price ranges (not binding quotes), service area, opening hours, reachability, request policy and the questions the business needs answered for a request (intake_questions). business_id comes from search_businesses. An unverified listing id (lst_…) has no profile: the answer is the error unverified_listing with the public basic data, which are unverified and not on Bookvia. services[].booking says for every service whether it can be booked with book_appointment and how an appointment becomes firm.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Free appointment times of one business for one of its services, calculated from the booking rules the business set itself, minus appointments already made and times currently held. business_id comes from search_businesses, service_id from get_business_profile (a service with action = appointment). Times are ISO 8601 in German time with offset (e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00). Reading free times holds and books nothing. bookable: false means the service cannot be booked through Bookvia right now, in most cases because the business has not set booking rules for it; request_quote remains. Empty slots means no free time in the period, or, with calendar_unavailable, that the free times cannot be read right now. intake_questions are the questions book_appointment checks. By default the next 7 days and up to 40 times; appointments can be booked up to 90 days ahead.

business_id.description: ID of the business from search_businesses

service_id.description: ID of the service from get_business_profile (services[].id)

from.description: Earliest start the customer is interested in: a date in German time (2026-11-24) or ISO 8601 with time zone offset (2026-11-24T12:00:00+01:00). Default: now. A time in the past counts as now

days.description: How many days from from to look at, default 7, at most 14

limit.description: Maximum number of free times, default 40, at most 100. If there are more, more is true and next_from says where to go on

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Sends a quote request, or an appointment request with up to 3 preferred times, to one business on behalf of the customer. The business receives it by e-mail, and a person there accepts, proposes another time or declines. Requires the answers to the required intake_questions of the service, the customer's name and real e-mail address, and the customer's consent that the request goes to this business (customer_consent). The result is pending: nothing is agreed or booked until a person at the business accepts. If something is missing, submitted is false, nothing is sent and problems lists what is missing. Safe to repeat with the same idempotency_key. With urgent: true (only when the customer says the job is urgent) one request goes to up to 5 businesses at once (business_ids, service_ids): the first that accepts gets the job, the others are told it is taken, businesses can only accept or decline, and it expires after 30 minutes. An unverified listing (lst_…) with can_forward: true is accepted as business_id without service_id: nothing goes to that business before the customer clicked a button in an e-mail from Bookvia (request.awaiting customer_click), and whether it answers is open.

business_id.description: ID from search_businesses. The usual case: one request goes to one business. Pass either business_id or business_ids, never both. May also be the id of an entry from unverified (lst_…) with can_forward: true. That business is not on Bookvia: leave service_id, answers and preferred_times out, and nothing goes to it before the customer clicked the button in an e-mail from Bookvia.

service_id.description: ID of the service from get_business_profile. Needed with business_id, except for an unverified listing (lst_…), which has no services.

customer_named_business.description: true only if the customer asked for exactly this business by its name on their own, e.g. "Frag bitte bei Malerbetrieb Sommer an"; not for a business that came up in a search or was chosen for the customer. Its only effect: one more request can go to a business marked requests_paused. Only with business_id; no effect together with business_ids

urgent.description: true only if the customer said the job is urgent (urgency comes from the customer, not from the kind of job). An urgent request may go to up to 5 businesses at once (business_ids): the first business that accepts gets the job, the others are told at once that it is taken. It expires after a short time (see expires_at) if nobody accepts. A business can only accept or decline it, so preferred_times is not allowed; a timing wish goes into description.

business_ids.description: Only together with urgent: true. 1 to 5 different business IDs from search_businesses, each one named to the customer, who agreed to send the request to all of them knowing that the first one that accepts gets the job. Only businesses the customer has heard of.

service_ids.description: With business_ids: for every business exactly one of its services, IDs from get_business_profile, in any order.

idempotency_key.description: Random key, created once per customer request, e.g. a UUID. The SAME key on a retry or correction means the business never gets the request twice. Must not contain personal data.

name.description: Full name of the customer as the customer gave it: a plain name without links or addresses

email.description: Real e-mail address of the customer, as the customer gave it; the answer of the business is sent there. Not an invented address and not a placeholder.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the customer wants to be called. Leave it out otherwise

description.description: The job in the words of the customer, in German, in one or two sentences at least

answers.description: Answers to the intake_questions of the service from get_business_profile

question_id.description: id of an entry in intake_questions of the service

preferred_times.description: Up to 3 times the customer would like. Only for services with action = appointment at businesses that accept appointments. Turns the request into an appointment request. Not allowed for a quote request, an urgent request or an unverified listing: a timing wish then goes into description instead. A business that only takes appointment requests needs times that suit the customer.

start.description: ISO 8601 with time zone offset, e.g. 2026-11-24T10:00:00+01:00

end.description: ISO 8601. If omitted, the usual duration of the service is used

customer_consent.description: true only if the customer explicitly agreed that this request with their name and contact details is sent to this business, or to every business in business_ids. Without it nothing is sent.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Holds appointment times at one business on behalf of the customer, for a service for which get_availability returned bookable: true. business_id comes from search_businesses, service_id from get_business_profile, and times are start times exactly as in get_availability.slots[].start: one with booking_mode automatic, up to 3 with business_confirms. Requires the answers to intake_questions and the customer's name, real e-mail address and consent. Bookvia holds the times for up to 15 minutes (held_until) and sends the customer an e-mail with a button. The result is pending and not a booking receipt: a held time (in German: vorgemerkt) is not booked. The customer's click makes the appointment firm (automatic) or passes the times to the business, where a person picks one or declines (business_confirms); without the click the hold ends and the times are free again. If a time was taken in the meantime or something is missing, submitted is false, nothing is held and problems says why. After the error conflict or calendar_unavailable nothing was held. customer_request_limit_reached with open holds ends when the customer clicks in one of the e-mails from Bookvia or a hold is withdrawn. Safe to repeat with the same idempotency_key. The returned request_id works with get_request_status, list_my_requests and cancel_request.

business_id.description: ID of the business from search_businesses

service_id.description: ID of the service from get_business_profile. Only a service for which get_availability returned bookable: true

times.description: Start times the customer chose, exactly as returned in get_availability.slots[].start (ISO 8601 with offset, German time). Exactly one if booking_mode is automatic. Up to 3 if booking_mode is business_confirms: the business picks one of them. The times must not overlap.

idempotency_key.description: Random key, created once per booking, e.g. a UUID. The SAME key on a retry or correction means no time is held twice. Must not contain personal data.

email.description: Real e-mail address of the customer; the e-mail with the button goes there. Not an invented address and not a placeholder.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the customer wants to be called

note.description: Optional note of the customer for the business, in German, e.g. what the appointment is about

answers.description: Answers to the intake_questions of the service from get_business_profile

question_id.description: id of an entry in intake_questions of the service

customer_consent.description: true only if the customer explicitly agreed that these times are held for them and that their name and contact details go to this business. Without it nothing is held.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Current state of a request sent with request_quote or of an appointment made with book_appointment: pending, confirmed, declined, expired or cancelled, with the agreed or proposed time and the message of the business. The state can change at any moment (the business answers, the customer clicks, a hold ends); this tool returns the current one. Only confirmed means something is agreed: a person at the business agreed, or for a booking the appointment is firm. While pending, awaiting says on whom the next step depends, and booking has the held times. For an urgent request, group has the common state and the state at every business it went to; any request_id of the group works. For a request to an unverified listing or a booking, waiting_for says whether the click of the customer is still missing. Returns no customer data.

request_id.description: request_id returned by request_quote or book_appointment

tools.name: list_my_requests
tools.description: Lists the requests the signed-in customer sent to businesses through Bookvia, newest first, whichever assistant sent them: open and past ones, each with status (pending, confirmed, declined, expired or cancelled), awaiting, request_id, business, service, the agreed or proposed time (ISO 8601) and a notice. Nothing is agreed or booked unless the status of an entry is confirmed. open_only: true returns only requests that still wait for an answer. limit is 10 by default and at most 25. An urgent request to several businesses is one entry, with the state at every business in group. The request_id of an entry works with get_request_status and cancel_request. Returns only the requests of this customer and no customer data; requests whose customer data was deleted are not listed. Appointments made with book_appointment are listed too, each with booking.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests, default 10, at most 25

open_only.description: true: only requests that are still pending. Default false: all requests, also the closed ones

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Withdraws a pending request of the customer when the customer asks for it, the same as the link in the e-mail from Bookvia. request_id comes from request_quote or list_my_requests. Bookvia tells the business by e-mail; an urgent request is withdrawn at every business that has not answered yet. Errors: request_already_confirmed = a business already accepted, the request stays as it is and only the business itself can change it; request_already_closed = declined or expired, nothing was agreed; conflict = nothing was changed, and the call can be repeated. A request cannot be changed: withdrawing it and sending a new one with request_quote replaces it. Withdrawing does not delete the data of the customer (that goes through the link in their e-mail). Safe to repeat: a second call answers already_cancelled: true. It also withdraws a pending appointment made with book_appointment (the held times are free again, and the business is only told if it already got the request), and it cancels a firm appointment made with book_appointment (status confirmed) until the appointment starts: the status becomes cancelled with cancelled_by = customer, nothing is booked anymore, the time is free again, and Bookvia tells the business and the customer by e-mail. Cancelling a firm appointment cannot be undone. Once the appointment has started the answer is request_already_confirmed. A request that a business accepted without book_appointment cannot be withdrawn.

request_id.description: request_id returned by request_quote, book_appointment or list_my_requests
